# Dependency notices

Generated by scripts/collect-third-party.py from the locked installed packages for an Apple Silicon macOS build. Includes installed npm packages, Cargo resolved packages and Go modules actually imported by the helper. Build/test dependencies and some other-platform Cargo packages are included conservatively. Optional npm binaries for other platforms are not installed here. This inventory does not relicense upstream code.

License/notice file contents are copied unchanged. Local cache paths and credentials are not included. Read inventory.json for package names, versions, reported licenses and notice hashes.

Missing notices: none.

Some registry archives omit their project license files. The inventory records notices retrieved from their exact upstream VCS revisions, same-version platform-parent notices, and standard license texts for declared alternatives. Original source declarations are retained. Five MPL-only dependencies also have their complete unmodified package sources in sources/. For alternatives that include LGPL, the Apache 2.0 option is retained; no upstream component is relicensed as MIT by the project LICENSE.
